part.text:
I could not open the Spaces area. The app is on the "All chats" screen, and the Spaces button is the grid icon with the "20" badge at the bottom-left of the screen. I don't have a way to tap it.

The tools available here can take screenshots, launch and stop apps, open URLs, and change appearance, but none can send touch input. `simctl ui` only handles appearance and contrast settings. `idb` isn't installed, and host GUI automation is unavailable as you noted. Setting up an XCUITest bundle to perform the tap would be the only route, and that's a substantial build I didn't attempt.

If you can grant a touch-input tool (for example, `idb ui tap` or a running XCUITest harness), I can tap the icon at the bottom-left. Otherwise, you can tap it yourself to open Spaces.
